name: Who Am I In Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that identity in Christ is defined by the believer's reception of Him, granting the right to become a child of God and experience a transformed life. Those who are in Christ Jesus are no longer under condemnation but are empowered to live by the Spirit rather than the flesh. Furthermore, believers are God's workmanship, created anew to fulfill the good works He has prepared for them, emphasizing both their new position and purpose in Him.
